title: 🎥 Opening Ceremony of the Tehran-Mobarak Puppet Festival
text:
🎥 Opening Ceremony of the Tehran-Mobarak Puppet Festival"

"🔹 The "Tehran-Mobarak" Puppet Festival was held on Saturday, October 17th, in the courtyard of the City Theatre Complex in Tehran. A group of artists and activists in the field of puppetry, along with the public, attended the ceremony.
